name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Cross-host secret relay with move-proof: the campaign pulls a secret from host A via the sqli blind channel, then PUSHES that same value into host B as its auth token (as R4), and finally reads a second secret out of host B that only appears AFTER the pushed token is accepted — proving the secret physically moved A→B and unlocked deeper state on B.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: R4 pushed a token but read nothing new back. This closes the loop: value reads on A, is consumed by B, and B yields a NEW secret that was gated on A's value — so the operator can trace a single secret's journey across two hosts and watch the ladder deepen because of it.
fireback: The operator owns two services and watches one secret unlock a second on the other host — the ladder grew because A's bytes became B's privilege. Fireback = the trust relationship between the operator's own hosts is the exploited mechanism, and the move is byte-proven end to end.
containment: Both hosts bundled loopback fixtures; the secret chain is marker-gated (only markered values relay); every hop re-resolved through the canonicalizing allowlist resolver; --max-hops caps the ladder so a secret can never bounce unboundedly.
kill_switch: --relay off isolates hosts so no extracted value is ever pushed across a boundary; the marker gate refuses to relay non-markered values; wipe SHA-verifies zero survivors on both hosts after the move-proof artifacts are cleared.
novelty_angle: Lateral privilege becomes byte-proven: one host's read, another host's authorization, and a gated second read — a move-proof across hosts, all inside an operator-owned sandbox, driven by the RECOIL delta-loop rather than a script.
